# JavaScript bindings: coverage

`javascript.bindings.expose_unimplemented` is on. A member not implemented is absent (`javascript.bindings.unimplemented = absent`, the default: feature detection sees it missing) or throws `NotSupportedError` (`throw`).

How a member is implemented: **C** hand-written (`native/js/runtime`), **import** a browser function of `api/*.widl`
